title: Science and Technology
parentNote: This unit covers basic science concepts, inventions, and technology around us. Great for building curiosity!
learnBullets: Learn about **sources of light** and energy
learnItFirst:
**1. Common Machines & Gadgets**

| Machine | What It Does |
|---------|-------------|
| Television 📺 | Shows pictures and videos |
| Computer 💻 | Helps us work, play, and learn |
| Telephone 📞 | Helps us talk to people far away |
| Refrigerator 🧊 | Keeps food cold |
| Fan 🪭 | Gives us cool air |

**2. Sources of Light**

- **Sun** — biggest natural source of light
- **Electric bulb** — man-made light source
- **Candle** — gives light when burning
- **Torch/Flashlight** — portable light

**3. Sources of Energy**

- **Sun** — gives us solar energy
- **Wind** — gives us wind energy
- **Water** — gives us hydro energy
- **Food** — gives us energy to work

**4. Famous Scientists**

- **Thomas Edison** — invented the light bulb
- **Alexander Graham Bell** — invented the telephone
- **Wright Brothers** — invented the aeroplane

questions.content: Which is the biggest source of light on Earth?
questions.why: The Sun is the biggest and main source of light on Earth

questions.content: Which machine keeps food cold?
questions.why: A refrigerator keeps food cold and fresh

questions.content: We use a ___ to talk to people far away.
questions.why: We use a telephone or mobile phone to talk to people far away

questions.content: Which of these gives us cool air?
questions.why: A fan or air conditioner gives us cool air

questions.content: What do we use to iron clothes?
questions.why: We use an electric iron to remove wrinkles from clothes

questions.content: Which machine shows us pictures and videos?
questions.why: Television (TV) shows us pictures, videos, and movies

questions.content: Plants need ___ to make food.
questions.why: Plants need sunlight, water, and air to make food

questions.content: Which of these is a natural source of light?
questions.why: The Sun is a natural source of light; bulbs are man-made

questions.content: What do we get from food?
questions.why: Food gives us energy to work, play, and grow

questions.content: Ice melts when it becomes ___.
questions.why: Ice melts and becomes water when heated or warmed

questions.content: Who invented the light bulb?
questions.why: Thomas Edison invented the practical electric light bulb

questions.content: What happens to water when it is heated?
questions.why: When water is heated, it turns into steam (water vapor)

questions.content: Who invented the telephone?
questions.why: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone

questions.content: Which machine is used to wash clothes?
questions.why: A washing machine washes clothes automatically

questions.content: What makes a magnet special?
questions.why: A magnet can attract iron and steel objects

questions.content: Which of these runs on batteries?
questions.why: A TV remote runs on batteries

questions.content: What do we call frozen water?
questions.why: When water freezes, it becomes ice

questions.content: Who invented the aeroplane?
questions.why: The Wright Brothers (Orville and Wilbur) invented the aeroplane

questions.content: We use a ___ to clean the floor.
questions.why: A vacuum cleaner sucks up dust and dirt from floors

questions.content: What material is used to make glass?
questions.why: Glass is made from sand heated to very high temperatures

questions.content: Which of these is a good conductor of electricity?
questions.why: Metals like copper and iron conduct electricity well

questions.content: What do solar panels use to make electricity?
questions.why: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity

questions.content: Which machine is used to heat food quickly?
questions.why: A microwave oven heats food quickly

questions.content: A computer's brain is called ___.
questions.why: CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the brain of a computer

questions.content: Which of these can float on water?
questions.why: Wood is lighter than water, so it floats

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: Test your science knowledge with these challenging questions!

questions.content: What is the boiling point of water?
questions.why: Water boils at 100°C (degrees Celsius)

questions.content: Rainbow has how many colours?
questions.why: Rainbow has 7 colours: Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red (VIBGYOR)

questions.content: What is the freezing point of water?
questions.why: Water freezes to become ice at 0°C (degrees Celsius)

questions.content: Sound travels fastest through ___.
questions.why: Sound travels fastest through solids, slower in liquids, and slowest in air

questions.content: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.why: Mars is called the Red Planet because of its reddish appearance
